note: A small synthetic graph shipped so a first question can be answered before anything is installed. Facts are invented, not scraped.

facts.name: USES_DATABASE
facts.fact: Aurora Analytics uses DuckDB as its database.

facts.name: MIGRATED_TO
facts.fact: Aurora Analytics migrated from DuckDB to PostgreSQL for its warehouse in June 2026.

facts.name: WRITES_SERVICE_IN
facts.fact: The payments team writes its services in Go rather than Python.

facts.name: REFRESH_STRATEGY
facts.fact: Aurora Analytics rebuilds its reporting tables nightly instead of streaming updates.

facts.name: REQUIRES
facts.fact: A release to production requires two approvals, one of them from the on call engineer.
